description: This Java class defines the AndroidGradleBuilder, a custom module-level builder for Android projects using Gradle in the IntelliJ IDEA build system. It manages build behavior, disables certain builders for Gradle projects, and specifies file extensions relevant to Android Gradle builds.

classes.name: AndroidGradleBuilder
classes.description: A custom module-level builder that disables non-Gradle build components for Android projects using Gradle, and manages build extensions and file types.

methods.name: AndroidGradleBuilder
methods.description: Constructor that registers resource processing enabler and sets up the builder category.

methods.name: buildStarted
methods.description: Disables IDEA's Java and Android builders for projects with the Android Gradle facet.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Determines if the module chunk is a Gradle project and returns the appropriate build status.

methods.name: getPresentableName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the builder.

methods.name: getCompilableFileExtensions
methods.description: Returns list of file extensions relevant for compilation in this builder.
